text:
For a long time I dreamed of you

thus, dressed in white tulle,

and to my soul that sought you,

I asked, Ana, what do you see?

as in Bluebeard's tale.


For a long time I sensed

your black eyes as I saw them,

and in my hours of nostalgia,

Sister Anne answered me:

“There is a virgin coming to you.”


And glimpsing you, feverish, awake,

behind the tower's ogive,

after having moved uncertainly,

like a bell that tolls for the dead,

my heart tolled for glory.


At last, different, you appeared to me;

reveille calls rang around,

the sad Muse silently fled

and you arrived, saw, and conquered

like the magnificent Emperor.


Today, my hope that runs toward you,

that looks to the sky where you may be,

because glory is unveiled to it,

no longer asks from the tower:

Sister Anne, tell me, what do you see?


Today in my night your light reigns,

I see your face shine,

and in my dreams I only wish

to raise you like a flag

and, embracing you, to conquer through you!

translation.title: For a Long Time I Dreamed of You
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the Bluebeard/Sister Anne allusion, military triumph imagery, and the final embrace.
